notes: Flycast (Dreamcast): pkgforge-dev's sharun repackaging of Flycast 2.7.

-config window:fullscreen=yes (also in the seed); the ROM must be the LAST argument (Flycast ignores everything after it). Started with a game, the menu's Exit quits Flycast instead of returning to its game list.
Select + Start opens Flycast's menu (pad mapping file); SIGTERM quits cleanly (resume state saved), no dialog.
gui_args: Flycast's own pad-driven UI and game list (~/roms/dc).

gamepad_profile guide-hotkeys.yaml: hold Guide for L1 load state, R1 save state (the current slot, 0: the one AutoSaveState also writes on exit), R2 fast-forward on/off, Start quit (btn_escape: dc_exit, as SIGTERM) — as keyboard F1-F4, bound in the seeded keyboard mapping (kbd.cfg, SDL_Keyboard.cfg: Flycast's keyboard defaults no longer load).
